record.field: Welcome to FAMTECH: Enrollment Confirmed for ${object.name}

Hello ${object.partner_id.name},

Thank you for enrolling in ${object.order_line[0].product_id.name}. We have received your payment.

Click here to go to your account or Book your preferred training schedule now.

Our Sales team will contact you shortly to confirm your preferred schedule. If it is confirmed, you'll receive a schedule confirmation email with the meeting link.

Regards,
FAMTECH Team
Next Steps: Complete your enrollment at FAMTECH

Hello ${object.partner_id.name},

Thanks for choosing ${object.order_line[0].product_id.name}. We noticed your payment method is ${object.x_payment_method or 'Manual / Bank Transfer'}.

Our Sales team will contact you soon to arrange the payment and complete your enrollment. If you have payment proof, please reply to this email attaching it.

Regards,
FAMTECH Sales

New enrollment details:

  • Customer: ${object.partner_id.name}
  • Course: ${object.order_line[0].product_id.name}
  • Order: ${object.name}

Please contact the customer to arrange payment.

Hello ${object.partner_id.name or ''},

Your training has been scheduled:

  • Course: ${object.name or 'TBD'}
  • Date & Time: ${object.start_datetime}
  • Meeting Link: ${object.videocall_location or 'Will be provided'}

Please join the virtual meeting 5 minutes before the start.

Hello ${object.name},

Congratulations! You earned ${object.x_last_points_earned} points for your recent training performance. You now have ${object.x_famtech_points} points total.

How to redeem: Use the generated coupon or select 'Use points' at checkout to apply a discount.
